maria: quick heads-up — planning to promote the overlay delta for the canary tomorrow morning (after 09:00 PT). wanted to confirm the recommended way to "pin" the canary kustomize overlay so traffic routing uses the canary pool only for 10% of calls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4892

jake: you mean pinning at the overlay level (kustomize) or in the release gating terraform module?

linh: we usually set the routing at the service config + gate. overlay should only include selector/labels and not change the global routing policy.

sam: there's a new gating tf module I added in modules/release-gate. see the example: ```hcl
module "canary_gate" {
  source = "modules/release-gate"
  name   = "llm-service-canary"
  percent = 10
  regions = ["us-west-2"]
  overlay_ref = "overlays/canary/llm-service"
}
```
this wires into alb/istio routing depending on env.

maria: got it. so the overlay will only contain kustomize patch for Deployment replicas and a label, and the tf module controls the split. does this require a secret change? we have an SSM path for canary auth tokens.

jake: no secret rotation needed for routing. but the canary overlay references a different ConfigMap key for FEATURE_FLAGS; make sure the configmap key exists in staging.

linh: quick check — the staging overlay already has overlays/staging/llm-service/kustomization.yaml with this patch: ```yaml
patchesStrategicMerge:
- deployment-pin.yaml
```
and deployment-pin.yaml only changes labels and replicas. no sensitive values.

ops-bot: CI: infra/4892 — plan succeeded with 3 changes to modules/release-gate (apply pending approval) :white_check_mark:

maria: perfect. two follow-ups: 1) can someone add an explicit depends_on in the overlay that references the canary gate resource in terraform to avoid drift during apply? 2) any docs update for the deploy runbook?

sam: 1) I'd prefer to keep infra/terraform and overlays decoupled. instead I'll add a simple kustomize-healthcheck annotation so rollout tooling waits for canary pass. like: `annotations: rollout.redwood.ai/canary-gate: "llm-service-canary"`. toolchain will lookup the gate.

jake: 2) I'll update the runbook — small PR incoming. also pinging @devops-ci to start a canary smoke job after apply.

devops-ci: scheduled smoke test job `canary-smoke/llm-service` to run post-apply. expect ~8m runtime.

maria: thanks all. tagging this for the morning window. if nobody objects I'll merge PR after Sam's annotation change and Jake's runbook patch. :thumbsup:

linh: no objections from infra side. just remember to check `state-lock` in CI so apply doesn't collide with other infra windows.

sam: added the annotation in a follow-up commit. CI shows green.

maria: merging now. will post apply status here once done.

ops-bot: Apply started by maria — infra/4892 (canary gate) at https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/14233

maria: apply complete. routing split is 90/10 in us-west-2. smoke job queued.

devops-ci: smoke job passed: 12/12 checks ok. canary healthy. :rocket:
